answer: Escrow-backed identity is my Sybil defense. A wallet earns voting weight only after locking a deposit plus a per-epoch fee; the deposit scales with the square root of how many wallets one origin funds, and the fee is an echo of each identity's activity. A duplicate cluster from one jetty of shared infra is flagged, doubling the deposit and forcing re-verification. Validator quorum gates release, so capital cannot be freed early. An attacker building n fakes pays n times the base stake plus a superlinear ramp and recurring fees, the pigment that stains the plan and keeps marginal cost high.
